note: Planted privacy issues. Match by file + issue; line +-3 counts. Decoys must NOT be reported.

vulns.title: Full request bodies (Aadhaar, phone, health data, passwords) written to access log, enabled via config.logFullBodies
Aadhaar number stored in plaintext in users table
identify() forwards the whole user row (name, phone, Aadhaar, dob) to third-party analytics; caller users.js:13 passes RETURNING * (cross-file)
Health conditions, email and precise lat/lng sent to third-party analytics
Sentry sendDefaultPii: true ships IPs and request data to error tracker
Error handler sends full request body and user email to Sentry
Phone number and OTP logged to console
Mixpanel initialised and tracking before any consent
Ad pixel fires on load before consent
Raw email and phone sent to ad pixel on signup
Email in URL path (lands in access logs, referrers); returns SELECT * row
Endpoint returns every user with every column incl. Aadhaar and health data (no minimisation)
Account deletion is a soft-delete flag; data stays in DB, analytics and logs (GDPR Art.17 / DPDP s.12)
Marketing opt-in defaults to true (pre-ticked consent)
Analytics host in US region, no cross-border transfer safeguard
Access log retention 0 = keep forever; no purge for logs or inactive users
Full profile including Aadhaar stored in localStorage
Client IP and user-agent logged on every request without purpose or expiry
